title: C0: Audit truncation sites (no code change)

title: C3: Hook pipeline fix — only rewrite segment before first pipe (3a) — fix #73 #74
description: Fix mangle of piped commands. Only rewrite segment before first |, leave | grep ... verbatim. See /tmp/rtco-c-beads.md section C3.
design: Current registry.rs already has pipeline_final_safe (only rtco grep/rg may be rewritten as final pipe stage, guarded by !search_uses_pattern_file). Bug #74 is tasklist|grep -ci: tasklist is Windows-only producer, pipeline tasklist|grep is treated as producer|final_safe grep. Fix: when producer is not rtco-tracked (tasklist, curl, etc) the final grep reads stdin from pipe, not repo — so skip pipeline_final_safe for non-rtco producers. Also handle #73 grep -iE a|b: the | inside quoted regex must not be treated as pipe (quote-aware tokenize already does this, verify not regressed). Change in discover/registry.rs: pipeline_final_command_is_safe or rewrite_pipeline_final_stage to check producer type.
acceptance_criteria: rtco rewrite 'tasklist | grep -ci cargo' not mangled; rtco rewrite 'grep -iE "a|b" file.log' still rewrites; git log | grep feat still rewrites; quoted | not split; cargo test passes; manual rtco rewrite checked
close_reason: Piped grep counting mode fix shipped: pipeline_final_safe now checks search_is_counting_mode (-c) and is_rtco_tracked_producer. Fix #73 #74, 2 new tests, main 5f3c5c4.

title: C1: Auto-tee gom về .rtco — every truncation gets recoverable hint (centralized)
description: Centralized auto-tee in toml_filter.rs pipeline. Every head/tail/max_lines truncation gets [+N hidden — first hidden: ...] + [full: cat ~/tee/...]. Raw stays global cache, logic gom về .rtco. See /tmp/rtco-c-beads.md section C1.
design: Centralized auto-tee in toml_filter pipeline (gom ve .rtco). apply_filter gets tee_slug: Option<&str>; when head/tail/max_lines truncates, append force_tee_tail_hint_with_preview(original, slug, kept+1). Raw stays global cache (~/.cache/rtco/tee, 0600, redacted, SENSITIVE blocklist), never inside .rtco project dir. force_tee_tail_hint_with_preview currently #[allow(dead_code)] not wired — this bead wires it first time. Non-TOML caps get shared helper. Hint: always preview.
acceptance_criteria: Every TOML truncation gets preview hint + cat recover; sensitive slugs blocklisted; cargo fmt/clippy/test pass; seq 100 via max_lines 20 shows hint
close_reason: Shipped as dc7a5a8. Centralized auto-tee: toml_filter apply_filter_with_meta() detects truncation, main.rs fallback emits force_tee_tail_hint_with_preview. 3 tests.

title: C2: Selective passthrough — errors verbatim, dedup warnings
description: Never silently drop error/warning. Only compress noise. Add unless to match_output, dedup warnings with count. See /tmp/rtco-c-beads.md section C2.
design: Conservative: never drop error/warning. Audit TOML match_output lacking unless -> add unless regex for error/FAILED/fatal. Ensure strip_lines_matching doesn't swallow error lines. Dedup repeated warnings via dedup.rs grouping (x20). Caps in truncate.rs unchanged, documented to apply after errors kept. No new caps, just ordering.
acceptance_criteria: No TOML swallow of errors; fixture error[E0308]+noise keeps error verbatim, hint present; no snapshot regression

title: C4: Bypass tracking — proxy rate breakdown in rtco gain
description: Track proxy bypass rate per command in rtco gain. No dashboard, just breakdown table. See /tmp/rtco-c-beads.md section C4.
design: Bypass aggregation in analytics/gain.rs or tracking.rs: group by slug, count total vs proxy (savings==0 or command starts with proxy). Extend rtco gain with Bypass section: command | total | proxy | rate sorted desc. Proxy tracking already exists, verify. No dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: rtco proxy grep foo shows in gain history; gain shows Bypass table after mixed invocations
close_reason: Shipped as 346e45c. get_bypass_rates() query + Bypass Rate section in gain output.
